title: Activity
description: A single learner-facing activity item tied to a curriculum-graph topic.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this activity (UUID v4).

topic_id.description: Foreign key into the curriculum graph topics table (e.g. 'loops', 'conditionals').

activity_type.description: Governs how the frontend renders and evaluates this activity.

prompt_text.description: The question or instruction shown to the learner. Plain text or lightweight Markdown.

code_snippet.description: The Python code block associated with the activity. Null when the activity is purely text-based.

options.description: Multiple-choice or reorder options. Required for predict_output and reorder_lines; null for fill_blank and spot_bug.

correct_answer.description: The canonical correct answer. For reorder_lines, a pipe-delimited ordered string of option values.

explanation.description: Shown after the learner submits. Explains why the correct answer is correct.

source_section.description: Traceable back-reference into the handbook markdown files.

heading.description: The exact section heading in that file, e.g. '4.6  for loops'.
